subject: EMEA pipeline hygiene: quick standup + action plan
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: EMEA Sales Team <emea-sales@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: EMEA pipeline hygiene: quick standup + action plan

Morning team —

Quick reminder ahead of finance kickoffs: we need a short, clean commit for EMEA that finance can ingest by end of day Friday. Please do the following before EOD Thursday for your owned opportunities:

- Update best stage to reflect buyer intent (Proposal, Negotiation, Commit) — avoid "Working"/"In Progress" as a catch-all.
- Confirm ACV and currency (use the attached template).
- Mark any deals with procurement or legal blockers in the notes field.
- Drop a one-line confirmation in this thread when you're done.

I've attached a one-page template (EMEA_commit_template_v3.xlsx) to make it quick. Finance will pull a rollup on Friday morning; if you miss Thursday we risk being excluded from the Q2 forecast.

Priority list: Laura — EU strategic accounts; Vivek — Nordics & DACH; Marissa — UK mid-market; Rishi — APAC-adjacent EMEA (UAE, Israel).

Thanks — aim for tidy rather than perfect. Small gaps are OK but please flag blockers so we can escalate.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of EMEA Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: EMEA_commit_template_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, EMEA Sales Team <emea-sales@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:06:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EMEA pipeline hygiene: quick standup + action plan

Thanks Tessa — will do. Quick note on two DACH deals:

1) HeliosBank — ACV in EUR, legal reviewing new data residency clause. I set stage to Negotiation but added a note: "Legal review 2027-04-05".
2) GridWorks — still gathering final PO; seller expects sign next week. Left as Proposal but will escalate to Rishi if procurement stalls.

I'll upload the template entries by EOD Thursday and ping here.

Vivek

Tessa — doing the cleanups now. Two quick asks for finance clarity:

- For multi-entity deals (e.g., HeliosBank), should we roll ACV up to parent currency or report localized values? Finance prefers parent currency but wants local currency attached. I'll add both columns in the template.
- For deals pending legal sign-off, do we include in commit with a footnote or hold in commit until signed? Our last commit review preferred to include with cautionary notes; confirm preference.

I'll push my sheet by Thursday morning.

Laura

Looping finance ops as requested. Rishi here — quick operational guidance from our last sync:

- Include deals in commit when seller confidence >= 70% and there is a signed commercial term sheet OR an explicit PO-date in calendar.
- If legal/procurement is the only blocker and we have a committed PO/term sheet, include with a footnote indicating the dependency.
- Please standardize currency at parent level and add a local-currency column — finance will convert but likes the parent rollup.

Cc'ing Finance Ops: Finance, please confirm if you need any alternate columns or a strict CSV layout for automated ingestion.

—Rishi

Hi all —

Finance ops confirming requirements so there's no back-and-forth on Friday: please provide a CSV with these columns exactly — DealID, AccountName, ParentCurrencyACV, LocalCurrencyACV, Stage, ExpectedCloseDate, LegalStatus, ProcurementStatus, OwnerEmail, Notes. If you include deals with term-sheets but pending legal, add "LegalPending" in LegalStatus and a short note.

We'll ingest the CSV into the forecast system at 08:00 UTC on Friday. Anything submitted after 07:30UTC risks not being included.

Thanks — Finance Ops
